verdict.rationale: First-party docs show reactive state updated like a plain variable (svelte-docs-5). $derived recomputes from its tracked dependencies (svelte-docs-6, svelte-docs-9), and $effect runs when reactive state changes (svelte-docs-7). The compiler output 'surgically updates the DOM' and does 'minimal work in the browser' (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-1), and reactive state can be shared across modules (svelte-docs-12). Missing for 10: an explicit doc statement that only dependent template/UI code re-runs (fine-grained granularity is implied, not spelled out), and independent hands-on corroboration of that fine-grained behaviour.
